subject: general
question: Which of the following chemical compounds is used in the manufacture of cement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CaO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Calcium oxide**, also known as **lime** or **CaO.**
 
• **Dissolves** in water, it produces the compound **calcium hydroxide**, which is most commonly used in the production of cement.
 
• With th**e generation** of a great deal of **heat**.
 
• Paste, **mortar**, and concrete are examples of **cement**-based materials, all of which have a high initial pH of **12.0** to **13.8**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Gypsum**, also known as the cement's "**retarding agent**," is a crucial ingredient that is primarily used to **control** the cement's **setting time**.
 
• Cement **clinker** can instantly condense when combined with **water** and release heat** without** the need for **gypsum**.
 
• The **natural elements** limestone, **shale**, and **clay,** to mention a few, are used to create cement, a **fine powder**-like substance.
 
• In a** kiln**, the component **ingredients** are heated to generate the little lumps known as "**clinker**," which are then **crushed** down while gypsum is added to create the more well-known **cement powder.**
